sloka: राक्षसानाम् वधे साह्यम् लंकायाः च प्रधर्षणे ।करिष्यामि यथा प्राणम् प्रवेक्ष्यामि च वाहिनीम् ॥६-१९-२३॥।।
transliteration: rākṣasānām vadhe sāhyam laṁkāyāḥ ca pradharṣaṇe ।kariṣyāmi yathā prāṇam pravekṣyāmi ca vāhinīm ॥6-19-23॥।।

translations.english: "You have heard of the (story of a) dove that offered his own flesh to an enemy who came to seek protection according to tradition (of hospitality)."
